gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Press Note on Provisional Estimates of GDP for Q1 FY2026-27 (new base year 2022-23 series), released August 31, 2026. Q1 FY27 real GDP grew 7.8% YoY (₹81.36 lakh crore vs ₹75.46 lakh crore); flat vs Q4 FY26's 7.8% (per MoSPI Provisional Estimates for FY25-26/Q4, released Feb 27, 2026), so not trending up quarter-on-quarter.

cpi.source: MoSPI Press Release of Consumer Price Index (base 2024=100) for July 2026, embargoed until 4 PM, August 12, 2026. All-India CPI inflation 4.45% YoY (rural 4.84%, urban 3.96%); food inflation (CFPI) 5.52%.

gsec10y.source: India 10-year G-Sec benchmark yield, market data reported via Trading Economics/Business Standard coverage of RBI/CCIL trading levels (direct rbi.org.in and ccilindia.com access unavailable to this run). Yield rose to a twelve-week high around 6.95-6.96% in early September 2026 on tighter policy expectations and elevated oil prices, up from ~6.6% a month earlier.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC unanimously (6-0) held the repo rate at 5.25% at its August 3-5, 2026 meeting, retaining the neutral stance — the fourth consecutive hold since the last cut (5.5%→5.25%) in December 2025. MPC raised FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.7% and lowered CPI projection to 5%. Next MPC meeting: October 5-7, 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Resolution, August 3-5, 2026 (via Forbes India / Business Standard / JM Financial MPC coverage).

gov_capex.note: Centre spent 37% of its FY27 capex target in the first four months (Apr-Jul 2026); capital spending up 30% YoY to ₹4.51 lakh crore against the ₹12.22 lakh crore FY27 Budget target — ahead of the 31% pace achieved in the same period last year. Capex-led growth push continues into FY27.
gov_capex.source: Controller General of Accounts (CGA) data via Business Standard, 'Govt meets 37% of FY27 capex target as April-July spending jumps 30%', published August 31, 2026.

china_plus_one.note: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal reported ~15% export growth in the first four months of FY27 and reiterated the USD 1 trillion export target, with electronics continuing to lead export growth (up >40% YoY in April 2026) on the back of the PLI scheme and continued China+1 diversification into Indian electronics/manufacturing. Government's March 2026 FDI easing for limited Chinese investment in electronics/capital goods remains in effect.
china_plus_one.source: Commerce & Industry Minister Piyush Goyal remarks at Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav 2026 (reported via Tribune India/IBEF, August 12, 2026); electronics export growth data (April 2026) via Organiser/industry reporting.

rural_recovery.note: IMD's August 31, 2026 update flagged August rainfall at 16% below average (lowest in 3 years), widening the seasonal monsoon deficit to 14% (from 13% at end-July), and forecast September 2026 rainfall likely below normal amid strong El Niño conditions. Kharif sowing YoY contraction narrowed to ~3% at end-July (from ~23% at end-June) after a brief July rain surge, but the renewed August deficit keeps rural sentiment under pressure.
rural_recovery.source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) monsoon update, August 31, 2026 (via Business Recorder / Mongabay India kharif-sowing coverage, early September 2026).
